_comment: How the Google sync behaves. Which accounts are connected lives in google-accounts.json, which the engine manages - connect and disconnect from the Accounts section of the dashboard.
_syncEveryMinutes_note: How often mail and calendars are re-read. Gmail has no push to a PC without a public server, so this is polling. Ten minutes is plenty for homework.
_calendarDays_note: How much of your Google calendars is kept on this PC, either side of today. The month view needs about a month each way.
_homeworkLookbackDays_note: How far back in the school inbox to look for assignments. Deadlines already more than two days past are never imported.
_replyWithinHours_note: How long an email can wait on you before the reply task starts counting as late.
_repliesCanShield_note: false: unanswered email can nag but can never block anything. Deciding a message needs a reply is guesswork, and guesswork should not lock your games. Set true only once you trust what it picks up.
_ladders_note: Leave empty for the defaults. To override, give any of 'homework', 'exam' or 'replies' a list of { afterMinutes, level } rungs. Negative afterMinutes means before the deadline.
